stories.title: Define malpractice and disciplinary action schema
stories.description: Create Pydantic models and internal data contract for malpractice signals including fields for state_board_actions (list), npdb_flag (boolean/unknown), action_count, severity_score (derived), and evidence_links (URLs). Ensure schema supports null/unknown states and negative-only scoring semantics (no positive boost for absence).
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/provider_detail_service.py (existing provider detail patterns, state board URL construction). ASSUMPTION: No existing malpractice schema; must be introduced in evaluate_care domain.

stories.title: Implement malpractice signal aggregation logic
stories.description: Build backend service logic to construct malpractice signal: (1) generate state board URLs per provider state, (2) detect known negative indicators from available data (e.g., NPI deactivation or sanctions proxy), (3) compute severity_score based on presence/count of actions, (4) enforce rule: presence reduces score, absence is neutral. Return structured malpractice object.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/provider_detail_service.py (state board URL logic exists). GAP: No automated ingestion of board actions; logic must rely on constructed links and proxy indicators.

stories.title: Expose malpractice measure in provider evaluation API
stories.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade and provider detail response to include malpractice measure object. Ensure compatibility with existing tool_router and response formats. Include evidence_links for UI rendering and clear flag when data is unknown vs confirmed clean.

stories.title: Unit and integration tests for malpractice measure
stories.description: Create tests validating: (1) schema validation (null vs populated cases), (2) correct negative-only scoring behavior, (3) correct construction of state board URLs, (4) API response includes malpractice object, (5) graceful handling of missing data. Include edge cases for unknown NPDB status.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/ (existing testing patterns). ASSUMPTION: No existing malpractice tests; must follow current pytest structure.
